facts.material: Styrofoam form covered with sisal and cattail (plaiting materials, ~75% of surface), plus birch twig slices, straw, banana leaf, plastic accents

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 4602 articles made directly to shape from plaiting materials
GRI 3(b): composite good; plaiting materials covering ~75% of the surface give the essential character
classification.rationale: Composite decorative owl whose essential character comes from the plaiting-material (sisal, cattail) covering about 75 percent of the surface; the in-force ruling N331116 on a similar decorative owl of grass, twig and sisal is at 4602.19.80.
